item.title: StupidMirror 0.7.3
item.description:
• Rework the License page. A status card at the top shows whether this Mac runs the free plan or is activated, without the duplicated "Activated" label and warning icon. The activation code field and button sit inside their own group with the help text below it, and the purchase link and account sign-in get their own rows with room to breathe. Once activated, the code field is hidden and only the account and claim options remain.
  • Restyle every Settings page to match the dashboard: the same rounded panels on the window background, borderless grouped rows, and a sidebar laid out like the device list. Labels no longer truncate or break Chinese words across lines.
  • The device list shows the real product image for each iPhone and iPad model, the same artwork Finder and Find My use. Simulators, Android devices and unknown models keep the platform symbol.
